known_good_reason: User directly confirmed v0.4.2 rendered fully and correctly after repeated earlier failures.
architecture: single-owner standalone renderer plus CSS-only readability layer
readability_layer_rule: readability-v42.css may change visual hierarchy only; it must not own DOM rendering, events, fold state, recovery, transforms, or section positioning.

loading.no_gap_rule: after success #loadWrap is hidden/display:none and margin/padding/height are zero

readability.goal: preserve information while preventing dense walls of text
readability.hero: separate market core assessment and current action into distinct visual blocks
readability.action_matrix: use fewer columns and emphasize the active phase

generated_text_budgets.market.summary: 2-3 short sentences, about 220 Korean chars max
generated_text_budgets.market.final_action: up to 3 actions, about 180 chars max

readability.detail_preservation: Move detailed evidence to changes/research/data_status/reference_sources instead of deleting it.

action_regression_guard.rule: #action .mr-body must contain actual notice and phase cards, never a bordered empty panel
action_regression_guard.fold_rule: collapse -> body height 0; expand -> body returns to real content height

fold_contract: delegated document click handler owns all fold buttons
collapsed body uses display:none and zero height
normal flow only; no transform/translate gap repair
performance: compounder and QQQ TradingView charts lazy-load near viewport
optional data failure must not delete core UI
android_back_contract: modal open -> hardware Back closes modal
hourly_automation_rule: Update market JSON only; never rewrite HTML/JS/CSS/VERSION. Keep UI-visible text within readability budgets.
rollback_rule: If a new UI change breaks rendering, compare against stable-v042-baseline.html and remove the readability layer first before adding any recovery script.
apk_done_definition: Browser QA success -> Android Actions success -> Artifact exists -> APK downloaded and integrity checked -> provide file directly to user
